items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: there was a guy named Mars hired all the bands.

ctx.x: Did you do much marching on Mardi Gras and some of the carnival clubs? Oh, yeah.
Sometimes I'd play for the garden districts or different clubs. Oh, yeah. Sometimes I'd play for the garden districts or different clubs.

Oh yeah, sometimes I'd play for the Garden Districts or different clubs and most of the time I'd play for Pop Lane and there was a guy named Mars hired all the bands. They used to hire my brother Richie two years in advance because he was the only guy with a little cornet that could hold a 17 piece brass band and put one cornet. They'd stop at City Hall and hear Richie coming. There comes Richie Bruns. They could tell him. Every course would go up an octave higher or a key higher. I see one day his lip was…
